reason: Alert 1 alert-TP: User input from request.getParameter('BenchmarkTest') flows directly to host variable, which is used in URI.create('http://' + host) at line 32. The DNS resolution check filters specific IP address types but does not sanitize the hostname itself—an attacker can provide a hostname that resolves to allowed IPs while targeting internal resources. Resolved sink value: http://<user-controlled-hostname>. Case TP driven by this SSRF alert.

evidence.note: User input param assigned to host, used in URI creation at line 32 without sanitization
